title: ICAI Takes Big Leap in Cooperative Sector Reforms with New Audit Framework & Capacity Building
content:
# ICAI Takes Big Leap in Cooperative Sector Reforms with New Audit Framework & Capacity Building

Ek important update hai for all Chartered Accountants! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne cooperative sector mein reforms ko aage badhate hue ek naya audit framework aur nationwide capacity-building programmes announce kiye hain. Yeh announcement October 30, 2026, ko kiya gaya hai.

Here's a quick lowdown on the key developments:

*   **New Audit Framework:** Cooperative sector mein accountability aur transparency badhane ke liye, Ministry of Cooperation ne Multi-State Co-operative Societies (Auditor's Report) Order, 2026 (MSCARO, 2026) ko October 14, 2026, ko notify kiya hai.
*   **ICAI's Contribution:** ICAI, apni Cooperation and NPO Committee ke through, is important initiative mein active raha hai. Humne draft Order review kiya aur Ministry of Cooperation ko ek comprehensive audit checklist submit ki.
*   **Guidance Note under Development:** Audit quality ko further enhance karne ke liye, ICAI MSCARO 2026 par ek Guidance Note bhi develop kar raha hai. Isse auditors ko key audit considerations mein structured reference milega aur audit practices mein consistency aayegi.
*   **Capacity-Building Programmes:** ICAI cooperative societies aur departmental auditors ko evolving financial, audit aur regulatory requirements ko meet karne ke liye knowledge aur skills provide karne ke liye capacity-building initiatives bhi undertake kar raha hai. Recently, aise programmes Leh aur Kargil mein organize kiye gaye hain.
*   **Objective:** In sab initiatives ka aim cooperative sector mein statutory audit framework ko strengthen karna, financial oversight improve karna, aur governance practices ko enhance karna hai, leading to greater institutional credibility and public confidence.
